talking_points: The FTC is now investigating both OpenAI and Anthropic over safety and competition concerns, just as Anthropic preps a blockbuster IPO.
A California CEO has been charged with smuggling $300 million of Nvidia chips to China, reviving questions about Nvidia's own compliance checks.
Stripe and AMD both went shopping this week, snapping up Parafin and World Labs to bulk up lending and 'spatial intelligence' respectively.
